source: OpenViewNear
target: 近景视图

source: &1322 I can't believe you turned it down!
target: &1322 真不敢相信，你竟然拒绝了！

source: &1323 The City Council was practically *begging* to give you the job!
target: &1323 市议会简直是在求你接下这个职位！

source: &1815 It didn't feel right. I didn't deserve it.
target: &1815 我觉得不合适。我还不配。

source: &1324 Well, since they had to 'retire' Dr Vargas, and you refused it, they had to give the job to Chigwa!
target: &1324 好吧，既然他们不得不让瓦尔加斯博士“退休”，你又拒绝了，那就只好让奇格瓦接任了！

source: &1816 And I'm sure she'll make a fine Central Coordinator.
target: &1816 我相信她会是个出色的中枢协调员。

source: &1817 After all, she's one of the only people left alive and not incarcerated who knows how it works.
target: &1817 毕竟，既了解中枢的运作方式，又还活着、也没进监狱的人，已经没剩几个了。

source: &1325 You could've been the most powerful man in the city!
target: &1325 你本可以成为全城最有权势的人！

source: &1326 I could've been best pals with the most powerful man in the city!
target: &1326 我本可以跟全城最有权势的人成为铁哥们！

source: &1818 Sorry, you'll just have to butter up to Dr Chigwa.
target: &1818 抱歉了，你只能去讨好奇格瓦博士了。

source: &1327 Should've figured you wouldn't take it.
target: &1327 我早该想到你不会接受。

source: &1328 You'd need more adversity before earning something like that.
target: &1328 你得再吃点苦头，才会觉得自己配得上这种职位。

source: &1329 Otherwise you wouldn't have anything to complain about.
target: &1329 不然，你都没什么可抱怨的了。

source: &1819 Speaking of complaining, how's the new recruit doing?
target: &1819 说到抱怨，新人怎么样？

source: &1330 She's unconventional, and everyone's noticing it.
target: &1330 她不按常理出牌，大家都注意到了。

source: &1331 Not quite getting along with everyone, but that's not what she's here for.
target: &1331 跟大家还不太合得来。不过，她来这儿也不是为了这个。

source: &1332 Got quite a brain on her though, hasn't she?
target: &1332 但她脑子是真好使，对吧？

source: &1820 Takes after her mother.
target: &1820 随她母亲。

source: &647 How do I look?
target: &647 我这身怎么样？

source: &1333 That's 'how do I look, SIR?' to you.
target: &1333 你该说：“我这身怎么样，长官？”

source: &648 Pfft. Whatever.
target: &648 嘁。随便吧。

source: &1821 Better note 'problems with authority' on the conduct report.
target: &1821 最好在行为报告上记一条：“不服管教”。

source: &1334 Takes after her father.
target: &1334 随她父亲。

source: &1822 Hah. Central, any update on Nina?
target: &1822 哈。中枢，妮娜有什么新消息吗？

source: &151 Dr Nina Jeong is under special observation.
target: &151 妮娜·郑博士正接受特别观察。

source: &649 Like, witness protection?
target: &649 比如，证人保护？

source: &1823 Probably something like that.
target: &1823 大概是类似的安排。

source: &1824 But still, I wish Central would tell us what she was up to...
target: &1824 不过，我还是希望中枢能告诉我们，她在做什么……

source: &1335 What do you mean, you can't see the difference?
target: &1335 什么叫你看不出区别？

source: &1825 Well no, I can't!
target: &1825 就是看不出来啊！

source: &1826 It looks like Central, it sounds like Central...feels like Central.
target: &1826 看起来像中枢，听起来像中枢……感觉也像中枢。

source: &1336 I'm amazed nobody in the city's noticed, either.
target: &1336 全城竟然也没人发现，我真没想到。

source: &1827 That was kind of the point of replacing it with a commercial AI, wasn't it?
target: &1827 用商用人工智能来替换它，不就是想要这种效果吗？

source: &1337 Yeah, you're right. Maybe it's only because I know that, really, it's not the same Central.
target: &1337 嗯，你说得对。也许只是因为我知道，它其实已经不是原来的中枢了。

source: &1338 Still, you don't look very torn up about it.
target: &1338 不过，你看起来倒没怎么伤心。

source: &1828 I've got more important things to worry about, now.
target: &1828 现在我有更重要的事要操心。

source: &1339 Yeah, you're suddenly a family man!
target: &1339 是啊，你突然就成了有家室的人了！

source: &1340 If you need any advice on how girls work, you can ask me.
target: &1340 要是想知道怎么跟女孩子相处，尽管来问我。

source: &2036 Speaking of girls, how's the new recruit doing?
target: &2036 说到女孩子，新人怎么样？

source: &1831 Hah. Any update on Galatea, 'Central'?
target: &1831 哈。“中枢”，伽拉忒亚有什么新消息吗？

source: &1342 She's a slippery girl.
target: &1342 那姑娘可不好抓。

source: &650 Galatea escaped?
target: &650 伽拉忒亚逃了？

source: &1343 Hacked the patrol car they were taking her in, and ran for it.
target: &1343 她黑进了押送自己的巡逻车，溜了。

source: &152 It is believed that she may have links with the anti-civil group 'Jahiliyyah'.
target: &152 据判断，她可能与危害公共秩序的组织“贾希利亚”有关联。

source: &153 Please begin research into its organizational structure within Newton. Central Out.
target: &153 请开始调查该组织在牛顿市的内部结构。中枢通话完毕。

source: &1344 Meet the new Central, same as the old Central.
target: &1344 新中枢上任，还是老中枢那一套。

source: &1345 Well...it sounds the same, at least.
target: &1345 嗯……至少听起来一样。

source: &1832 Huh...well, hacker orgs like Jahiliyyah are a bit out of my field.
target: &1832 唔……贾希利亚这样的黑客组织，可不在我的专长范围内。

source: &1346 Don't worry, we've got an expert on staff now, don't we?
target: &1346 别担心，咱们现在不是有这方面的专家了吗？

source: &651 Well, actually...I know somewhere that they've got a connection...
target: &651 其实……我知道有个地方，跟他们有联系……
